english.title: Unqualified person pretending to be a solicitor
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being an unqualified person, wilfully

(A)_[pretended to be]_
(B)_[took or used a name, title, addition or description which implied that you were qualified or recognised by law as being qualified to act as]_

a solicitor
english.legislation: Contrary to section 21 of the Solicitors Act 1974.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
unqualified person wilfully
pretends to be or takes/uses any name/title/addition/description
implying that he is qualified/recognised by law as qualified
to act as a solicitor

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) No person shall be qualified to act as a solicitor unless his name is on the roll - i.e. the list of solicitors kept in accordance with section 6(1) of the Act - and he has in force a practising certificate (section 1) and a person who is not qualified is referred to in this part as an "unqualified person".
(ii) Proceedings under this Section may be brought within two years of the commission of the offence or within six months after the first discovery thereof by the prosecutor, whichever period expires first.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale.

Complex - see legislation
